verdict.rationale: gstack is a local pack of skills and methodology for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It has no hosted service or API of its own for which it could issue scoped or least-privilege credentials. Credential issuance therefore falls outside this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows gstack ships any such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
